propositions: The committed .bridge_state cache in the tickets branch comprises 92% of the 1.04 GiB repository size, with fields baseline_advanced_at and last_get_pass causing 1144 and 20 changes per reconciler pass that defeat git delta compression

Deleting the timestamp field baseline_advanced_at reduces marginal cost per version from 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB; moving last_get_pass to a separate file halves version churn, achieving 12.8x total reduction

The reconciler runs on ephemeral GitHub runners requiring durable state in git; the solution keeps the cache committed but makes it cheap through selective field removal and rotation bookkeeping relocation

A one-time history rewrite using git fast-export/fast-import with --no-data reduces the branch from 1.17 GB to 98.8 MB (8.4%) while preserving all 49,888 commits and 2,661 merges and making HEAD tree byte-identical to pre-rewrite state

Rollout gates are operator-attested: A2-2 requires descendant workflow execution with explicit host refresh and mixed-version self-healing oracle; reclaim requires live epoch-refusal probes, deployment receipts, off-repo bundle verification, and quiesced publication window

Post-publish rollback is a quiesced operator-controlled process using the off-repo bundle to restore the old tip with fail-closed epoch-mismatch refusal at union and push sites, without resumable state
